title: Treasury Marketable Borrowing Estimates (Q1 2027 / Q2 2027), 15:00 ET
source: EST: derived from the pairing this calendar's two existing borrowing-estimates entries already document — the Financing Estimates publish at 15:00 ET on the Monday two days before the 08:30 ET Wednesday Quarterly Refunding Statement (treasury-borrowing-estimates-2026-11-02 paired with treasury-refunding-2026-11-04, and treasury-borrowing-estimates-2027-05-03 paired with treasury-refunding-2027-05-05). This calendar already tracks treasury-refunding-2027-02-03 as the February 2027 refunding Wednesday, itself derived from a primary-anchored day-of-month rule re-derived from api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov auction announcement dates; the Monday two days earlier is 2027-02-01. Filed estimate because Treasury publishes its refunding schedule exactly one quarter ahead and no primary names any 2027 date — home.treasury.gov/policy-issues/financing-the-government/quarterly-refunding/most-recent-quarterly-refunding-documents, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 73,662 bytes), reads '(The next release is scheduled for November 2, 2026)' for the Monday estimates and '(The next release is scheduled for November 4 , 2026)' for the Wednesday statement and stops there — and because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Promotion to TSY:/confirmed is expected at the 2026-11-02 release, which by this series' own convention names its successor. Discovered 2026-09-09 during the never-assessed initial research of sloos-2027-02-01, where it is the 15:00 ET leg of that session's three-release collision
notes: PROPOSED, not canonical — the QUANTITY half of the February 2027 refunding pair, one hour after the SLOOS release that found it. Impact low, matching treasury-borrowing-estimates-2026-11-02, whose own initial research measured release day as nil across all 15 releases since 2023 (TLT +0.056%, p=0.860; SPY +0.201%, p=0.704; ^TNX +0.041%, p=0.989 on the 8 releases clear of an FOMC meeting-eve). Its relevance to the proposer is attribution, not price: 2027-02-01 already carries ism-manufacturing-2027-02-01 at 10:00 ET (high) and SLOOS at 14:00 ET, on the first trading day of a month that is also a Monday — a session class that runs SPY +0.275% (p=0.078, n=77) with no release attached at all. Three releases and a month-turn on one session means no move on that date is attributable to any of them. Estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
